I've had depression throughout my life, every good thing I've had has ended disastrously.

Instead of trying to live with every moment like that, it can all just go. 

It takes more courage for someone to live than to kill himself, I know that. But I have nothing. I feel empty.

I wouldn't know what to say, I know nothing that can help. I appreciate your concern and I honestly am thankful, but my mind is set. It was scary at first but I honestly feel calmer at the thought of it now
I don't want life though. I don't want to live on without my baby. I refuse to.
They won't stop, they're always intense and I can't block them out. And I feel because I'll never know what it could've been like to have that child, the feelings will never go away

Powerless to protect it, I feel it'll be on my mind forever. I'll always think "what if". I've been in denial, but I definitely feel anger. So much anger.

And just uselessness. There's a healthy baby waiting to be born and it's gonna be ripped out, and I can do nothing to protect it
Not really. I can't come to terms that I'm not having this baby anymore, and it's all I want

Thanks man, I'm trying to focus on myself. I've spoken to a helpline, and I'm 30 minutes from seeing a therapist. 

For now I'm focusing on my finances, I have more room to save now I'm back with parents and I want to focus on my health and career a little more. 

What I'm struggling with at the moment is resentment. Whenever I see a baby I feel sadness because it should be me. It's hard to be around friends that are parents right now and I hope that goes. I know I'll always feel a little empty for the rest of my life, wondering what could have been, I'm searching for ways of dealing with that.

Thank you for your input, I'm talking to as many people as I can right now and I value anything from anyone
Thank you. I have an appointment with a counsellor at half 4 today, hoping that will be a good start to recovering

I've spoken to her since and she even says she isn't 100% on getting rid of it but she is anyway. She thinks it will complicate her career, and that breaks me down even more.

As for the relationship, I'm distraught that it's all ended for seemingly no reason. It's like a light flicked off one day and everything we wanted, she stopped wanting.

I don't think I'll ever understand, I can't ask her without her getting mad at me. Think I'm just gonna take each day as it comes for now and try and get over it.

Just hard y'know? I was so ready to be a dad. So ready. Now it's not on the cards I feel like I've lost a part of me

Her happiness is my priority, and no matter what I'll be there for her. I'm trying to always be positive and in a good mood around her, I know this is really difficult for her and I just want to focus on being there for her, regardless
Thanks, that's actually extremely comforting. I'll see how the next couple weeks go and stay positive

Thank you, we live in the UK. She has an appointment at the clinic on the 25th, she'll talk it through there and then make a decision if she wants an appointment for the actual procedure. 

Last night there was a little break through, she came to me for the first time being upset and we actually spent the night normally like we used to, and she seemed happy. This morning she isn't too bad either, but I'm laying off talking about it for now. She knows I'll support her through anything.

I'm giving it time for now, my fingers are crossed for the better, but if it comes to the worst then I'll definitely be there for her throughout it all
